procedure.admission: KEEP an actual self-fulfilling future event within one Aethel civil year:400days*24hours*3600=34560000 elapsed world seconds. No invented epoch, equinox or primordial-Cycle conversion. NEW finite declaration grammar for this return is DELIVER(existing ordinary nonliving owned item, one known supported destination, before original one-year deadline). State exact item/owner/custodian/anchor and objective first-arrival predicate, not a vague omen, already-true statement, living death, global wealth or coerced belief. This bounded grammar and direct fate transport are NEW local spell authorship delivering a genuine future benefit, not recovered source facts. Actual caster ownership/consent, nonartifact status, legal custody, fully known protected destination and complete dependency history are required. Missing actual item/geometry/claim facts hold that case.
procedure.conflicts: NEW shared local registry across Fate Rewrite/Collapse Timeline/Eternal Prophecy: older committed source/obligation IDs win; a later declaration may not erase its creation/payment/fulfillment or make its objective impossible. Reject contradictions, recursion, already-true predicates and incompatible unique-item destinations before cost; permit ordinary compatible movement/history changes. Admission offers only generic unavailable feedback for protected facts. Caster death does not cancel an otherwise valid created obligation and cannot create a successor caster/body. Save/load preserves pending status and all route attempts. Instantaneous is creation timing, not proof the obligation is nonsuppressible; interventions retain actual magical suppression. Cancellation/failure at deadline would qualify the guarantee and is recorded as a blocker, never called successful fulfillment. Completed real delivery remains physical history despite later dispel/Null.
procedure.plan: NEW proposed guarantee mechanism TF192-GUARANTEE-01: commit one unique source-owned obligation after successful Action/V/S/F/26RP cast; preserve original deadline and immutable payment. Choose a normal lawful delivery route and an alternate route with explicit owners, decisions and costs. No autonomous actor action, resources or success is fabricated. A dormant source may request those ordinary actions but cannot force a third party to comply. A bounded direct delivery contingency is therefore required for an unconditional guarantee: move the same declared ordinary item exactly once to its reserved legal destination, no body/reward/item duplication. Interventions are magical expressions subject to actual suppression and property/physical constraints. A source cannot claim it guarantees a valid arrival solely because both currently authored routes succeed.
procedure.unresolvedGuarantee: BLOCKER TF192-B02. The native promise is unconditional must come true, but the available authored direct-delivery contingency cannot demonstrate fulfillment if all lawful routes and the actual magical intervention remain prevented through the deadline, or a genuine external artifact/finality/physical event removes the item or destination. This return does NOT invent indestructibility, a forceful universal preemption interrupt, global veto of future choices, or blanket antimagic immunity to hide that contradiction. Positive finite route traces, obstruction recovery, saved state and caster-death independence are demonstrated as conditional obligations, not proof of the full guarantee. The identity remains unaccepted until an explicitly authorized finite mechanism and its adversarial closure are evidenced, or the owner explicitly qualifies the promise. Preserve the exact unmet branch, no fulfilled receipt is fabricated.

sharedRequirements.access: Keep every native placement and classAccess row. Rank9/minimum class17/base26RP, V/S/F; Action except the actually acquired Universal Time Stop Reaction. sharedRequirements.clocks: World elapsed time is monotonic except it is paused during the explicitly authored Time Stop interval; no time is rewound by bookkeeping. Ordinary regular starts/end markers, six-second recharge, death saves, Ready, persistent pulses, source-relative duration, rest and finite-use histories remain separate clocks. Each full-state case records actor schedules and all due starts/ends, or explicit outside-initiative elapsed ticks. An administrative event is not a turn. sharedRequirements.commit: Before commitment validate live body, actual class/repertoire, Action or exact Reaction trigger, audible V, free gesture hand, possessed focus, targets/geometry and adequate resources. Compute limit=max(4,2+PB+max(0,casting modifier)); surcharge1 at limit and2 at limit+3; ordinary ranked casting blocked at limit+6. Base strain2 for rank9; consecutive same-name Refrain1,2,3 capped; Wizard first actually prepared family waives base only. Preserve real class exceptions and mandatory hooks. Pay once, update history once, end incompatible concentration only if this cast requires it, then offer real cast-time counters. Countered, interrupted or later-invalid legal casts keep payment/cadence and never restore displaced concentration. Invalid preflight pays nothing. Ordinary eligible Wizard Arch Counterspell is rank1/3RP/Reaction/recharge2, INT+PB task vs10+2rank, not an acquired ordinary spell by name; its actual acquired feedback/bonuses still apply.
sharedRequirements.persistence: Serialize source/cast/parent/child IDs, original clock domain/endpoint, immutable rolls and lineage, source/version references, complete bodies/resources/conditions, audit histories, custody and per-observer memories, pending transactions and obligations. Save/load and mode transitions preserve them byte-semantically; no cost, pulse, draw, award or grant replays. sharedRequirements.physical: Real occupied body volumes, support, hands, item identities, custody, focus, sight/line of effect and source range are checked at their actual stage. Default real-world/campaign input is unknown until supplied; a synthetic scene is labelled as such.
sharedRequirements.ready: Only Action-time modes can use ordinary Ready. Spend Action, commit actual cast once including costs, cadence, components and counter window; hold concentration even for a normally nonconcentration spell. At release, after the actual perceivable trigger, spend legal Reaction and recheck all targets/geometry. No second cast or payment/counter window. Effect duration begins on release; Ready expires at original next regular own-start. Invalid/declined triggers spend no release Reaction, without extending that deadline. Replacing, concentration loss, expiry or countering loses the held spell without refund. Universal Time Stop cannot be generically Readied.
